speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you; your age and the presence of painless rectal bleeding with a palpable mass are concerning. Have you noticed any recent unintentional weight loss, night sweats, or a change in your stool caliber?

speaker: Doctor

Painless daily rectal bleeding with a palpable mass is highly suggestive of malignancy; have you noticed any recent unintentional weight loss or fatigue?
